candidate_training.rule: Repeat the recorded architecture, training split, preprocessing, optimizer and learning-rate schedule; retain every completed epoch through min(119, the unchanged training policy native early-stop epoch).
candidate_training.reason: Intermediate checkpoint weights from the source run were not retained.
candidate_training.incomplete_candidate_set: Accept a shorter contiguous cohort only with verified native training completion (patience_cycles_exhausted); interrupted, paused or arbitrary partial cohorts must fail.
candidate_training.interruption_rule: Pause, user cancellation or an incomplete epoch is not successful native early stopping.

matching_config.failed_match: Report the selected checkpoint and both gaps; if validation or test gap exceeds tolerance, matched-response interpretation is unsupported. Do not replace the checkpoint after inspecting test.
matching_config.candidate_epochs_interpretation: maximum planned epoch range; actual complete cohort may end earlier only at verified native early stopping
